doclang.heading: Refund Policy
doclang.text: Customers may request a full refund within 30 days of purchase for annual plans.
doclang.heading: Monthly plans
doclang.text: Monthly plans are not refundable, but cancellation stops the next renewal.
doclang.heading: How to request a refund
doclang.text: Open a ticket with the billing team and include the invoice number. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days.
